Important Operational Notice

Programme Attendance and Movement

This guide is intended for staff convenience during approved free periods. Participation in external activities must not affect attendance, punctuality or official programme commitments.

All opening hours, travel times, ratings and business operations are subject to change. Staff should verify current information through Google Maps, Waze or the establishment before departure.

Emergency & Essential Support

🚨 Call 999Malaysia’s emergency number for police, fire and ambulance assistance. 👮 Police stationsOpen current nearby station results and directions. 🏧 ATM & bankingFind nearby cash and banking facilities. 🛒 Convenience storesDrinks, personal items and basic supplies. 🛞 Tyre & workshopRoadside support and basic vehicle services.
Medical searches: hospitals, clinics and pharmacies are already available in Nearest to Me and Live Nearby Searches. Confirm operating hours before travelling and share your live location during an emergency.

Prayer, Group Dining & Accessibility Guidance

Planning itemStaff guidance
Friday prayerUse a mosque specifically identified for congregational prayer, verify current Friday-prayer arrangements and leave 30–40 minutes early. Do not assume every surau hosts Friday prayer.
Large groupsContact the restaurant before departure. Confirm seating, reservation, parking, set menu and payment arrangement.
Dietary needsDo not assume certification from a map category. Confirm halal status, allergens and vegetarian requirements directly.
AccessibilityConfirm step-free access, accessible toilets, elderly-friendly walking distance and drop-off arrangements.
WeatherAvoid exposed beach areas during lightning, thunderstorms, rough seas or official weather warnings.
♿
Accessible diningVerify accessibility directly
 👥
Group restaurantsCall ahead for seating
